description: 12 consecutive Zcash Testnet headers (4,488,560 .. 4,488,571) after a trusted checkpoint at 4,488,559: the anchor of a real deposit proof (test/fork/DepositProofs.t.sol) and the work on top of it

source.headers: Zcash Testnet P2P network, `getheaders` (protocol 170180) via contracts/test/relay/tools/zcash_p2p_headers.py from public Testnet peer(s) found via the DNS seeders: (protocol 170180, /Zebra:7.0.0-rc.0/); (protocol 170190, /Zakura:1.6.0/)
source.verification: SHA256d recomputed for every header and hashPrevBlock linkage checked; tools/zcash_header_check.py re-checks Equihash, PoW, nBits retarget and time rules offline
source.cross_check: every entry compared with CipherScan Testnet API (https://api.testnet.cipherscan.app/api/block/<height>) on 2026-10-11: hash, previous hash, time, nBits; for the full headers also version, merkle root, nonce and solution. All matched.
